arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
APP=/srv/lowcost-europa
ACCOUNT=le001_1789265592
PREVIOUS=28c998e88bb723424c8ed36d4ba93904339ec877
TARGET=8b8bdaeaeb49f01def64b127f1b0c1459d5cf24e
checkout_started=no

app_manage() {
  sudo -n bash -c '
    set -a
    . /etc/lowcost-europa/lowcost-europa.env
    set +a
    export DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE=config.settings.production
    cd /srv/lowcost-europa
    runuser -u le001_1789265592 -- .venv/bin/python manage.py "$@"
  ' bash "$@"
}
on_exit() {
  rc=$?
  trap - EXIT
  if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo 'ROLLOUT_STATUS=failed'
    if [ "$checkout_started" = yes ]; then
      set +e
      sudo -n -u "$ACCOUNT" git -C "$APP" checkout --detach "$PREVIOUS" >/dev/null 2>&1
      checkout_rc=$?
      app_manage collectstatic --noinput >/dev/null 2>&1
      static_rc=$?
      sudo -n systemctl restart lowcost-europa.service >/dev/null 2>&1
      restart_rc=$?
      actual="$(sudo -n -u "$ACCOUNT" git -C "$APP" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null)"
      if [ "$checkout_rc" -eq 0 ] && [ "$static_rc" -eq 0 ] && [ "$restart_rc" -eq 0 ] && [ "$actual" = "$PREVIOUS" ] && systemctl is-active --quiet lowcost-europa.service; then
        echo 'ROLLBACK_STATUS=pass'
      else
        echo 'ROLLBACK_STATUS=failed'
      fi
    else
      echo 'ROLLBACK_STATUS=not_needed'
    fi
  else
    echo 'ROLLOUT_STATUS=success'
    echo 'ROLLBACK_STATUS=not_needed'
  fi
  exit "$rc"
}
trap on_exit EXIT

test "$(stat -c %U "$APP")" = "$ACCOUNT"
test "$(sudo -n -u "$ACCOUNT" git -C "$APP" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$PREVIOUS"
test -z "$(sudo -n -u "$ACCOUNT" git -C "$APP" status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=normal)"
for unit in lowcost-europa.service nginx.service postgresql.service; do systemctl is-active --quiet "$unit"; done
systemctl is-active --quiet lowcost-europa-affiliate-report.timer
test -x "$APP/.venv/bin/python"
latest="$(sudo -n find /var/backups/lowcost-europa/daily -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'lowcost-europa-*.dump' -printf '%T@ %f\n' | sort -nr | head -1 | cut -d' ' -f2-)"
[[ "$latest" =~ ^lowcost-europa-[0-9]{8}T[0-9]{6}Z\.dump$ ]]
dump="/var/backups/lowcost-europa/daily/$latest"
age=$(( ($(date -u +%s)-$(sudo -n stat -c %Y "$dump"))/3600 ))
test "$age" -ge 0 && test "$age" -lt 36
sudo -n bash -c 'cd /var/backups/lowcost-europa/daily && sha256sum --status -c "$1.sha256"' bash "$latest" >/dev/null 2>&1
sudo -n pg_restore --list "$dump" >/dev/null 2>&1
sudo -n test -f /var/lib/lowcost-europa/offsite-backup.last-success
offsite_age=$(( ($(date -u +%s)-$(sudo -n stat -c %Y /var/lib/lowcost-europa/offsite-backup.last-success))/3600 ))
test "$offsite_age" -ge 0 && test "$offsite_age" -lt 36
echo 'BACKUP_PREFLIGHT=pass'
sudo -n -u "$ACCOUNT" git -C "$APP" fetch --no-tags --no-recurse-submodules https://github.com/martaxi-boss/lowcost-europa.git refs/heads/main >/dev/null 2>&1
test "$(sudo -n -u "$ACCOUNT" git -C "$APP" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$TARGET"
sudo -n -u "$ACCOUNT" git -C "$APP" merge-base --is-ancestor "$PREVIOUS" "$TARGET"
altered="$(sudo -n -u "$ACCOUNT" git -C "$APP" diff --name-only "$PREVIOUS" "$TARGET")"
expected="$(printf '%s\n' .github/workflows/final-audit.yml PROJECT_STATE.md apps/catalog/owner_panel_views.py apps/catalog/services/observation_display.py apps/catalog/templates/catalog/owner_panel/dashboard.html apps/catalog/tests/test_owner_analytics_dashboard.py apps/storefront/templates/storefront/components/offer_card.html apps/storefront/tests/test_observation_display.py | LC_ALL=C sort)"
test "$altered" = "$expected"
echo 'EXACT_DIFF=pass'

checkout_started=yes
sudo -n -u "$ACCOUNT" git -C "$APP" checkout --detach "$TARGET" >/dev/null 2>&1
test "$(sudo -n -u "$ACCOUNT" git -C "$APP" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$TARGET"
echo 'CHECKOUT=pass'
app_manage check >/dev/null 2>&1
echo 'DJANGO_CHECK=pass'
app_manage check --deploy >/dev/null 2>&1
echo 'DJANGO_DEPLOY_CHECK=pass'
app_manage makemigrations --check --dry-run >/dev/null 2>&1
app_manage migrate --plan >/dev/null 2>&1
echo 'MIGRATION_DRIFT=pass'
app_manage shell -c 'from django.conf import settings; assert settings.PUBLIC_INDEXING_ENABLED is False and settings.DEBUG is False' >/dev/null 2>&1
echo 'NOINDEX_SETTINGS=pass'
app_manage shell -c 'from apps.catalog.services.observation_display import observation_history_queryset; assert observation_history_queryset().count() >= 0' >/dev/null 2>&1
echo 'OBSERVATION_QUERY=pass'
app_manage collectstatic --noinput >/dev/null 2>&1
echo 'COLLECTSTATIC=pass'
sudo -n systemctl restart lowcost-europa.service
ready=no
for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8; do
  if systemctl is-active --quiet lowcost-europa.service && [ "$(curl -sS --max-time 5 -H 'Host: lowcost-europa.duckdns.org' -H 'X-Forwarded-Proto: https' -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8001/health/ready/ 2>/dev/null)" = 200 ]; then ready=yes; break; fi
  sleep 1
done
test "$ready" = yes
echo 'READY_LOCAL=pass'
host_args=(-H 'Host: lowcost-europa.duckdns.org' -H 'X-Forwarded-Proto: https')
page="$(curl -fsS --max-time 12 "${host_args[@]}" http://127.0.0.1:8001/)"
grep -Fq 'name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow"' <<< "$page"
robots="$(curl -fsS --max-time 12 "${host_args[@]}" http://127.0.0.1:8001/robots.txt)"
grep -Fq 'Disallow: /' <<< "$robots"
for slug in cavitacao-rf-vacuum-corpo hydrodermoabrasao-aqua-facial-multifuncoes pressoterapia-vacuum-drenagem hifu diodo-laser-remocao-tatuagens-pigmentacao; do
  test "$(curl -sS --max-time 8 "${host_args[@]}" -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "http://127.0.0.1:8001/products/$slug/" 2>/dev/null)" = 200
done
test "$(curl -sS --max-time 10 "${host_args[@]}" -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' 'http://127.0.0.1:8001/pesquisar/?q=HIFU' 2>/dev/null)" = 200
test "$(curl -sS --max-time 10 "${host_args[@]}" -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8001/painel/ 2>/dev/null)" = 302
echo 'PUBLIC_AND_PRIVATE_SMOKE=pass'
systemctl is-active --quiet lowcost-europa-affiliate-report.timer
test -z "$(sudo -n -u "$ACCOUNT" git -C "$APP" status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=normal)"
test "$(sudo -n -u "$ACCOUNT" git -C "$APP" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$TARGET"
printf 'DEPLOYED_SHA=%s\n' "$TARGET"
echo 'WORKTREE_HYGIENE=pass'
